Identify a smoothed left-to-right rise in density dominance

Source: R/cp_uns_loc_filtering.R
dot-getCpUnsLocMarginalDominanceStart.Rd

Stimulated and unstimulated densities are smoothed by Gaussian kernel regression using half the fixed density bandwidth. When a derivative threshold exists, densities to its right are first collapsed to their respective means. A dominance threshold requires an observed transition from non-dominance to dominance. Its location is two-thirds of the onset location plus one-third of the subsequent dominance-score peak location.

Usage

.getCpUnsLocMarginalDominanceStart(
  density,
  startX = NA_real_,
  densityBw = NULL,
  dominanceRatio = 2,
  onsetWeight = 2/3,
  lowerBoundX = NA_real_
)
